prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: How do I find out if my global upgrade certificates have cleared?
Delta: Hello, Tim. If your upgrade has cleared you will have a seat in the forward cabin.  *HDG

Customer: Is upgrade to DeltaOne using global upgrade certificate currently available for #39 SEA-HKG on 11/10/17?  Or just waitlist?
Delta: Looks like there's no space to confirm you on that flight for a Global Upgrade, Larry. Sorry about that.  *HMB

Customer: How many times are you going to “upgrade” me to a middle seat?  Especially after I’ve unselected the Delta Comfort upgrade option?
Delta: Thanks for bringing this to our attention. I apologize for the confusion. *AMC

Customer: I’ve always been a fan but this trip you’ve really messed up and need to compensate DL4448 passengers
Delta: Please DM your confirmation # so I may look into this matter further for you. *TJF https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: loyalty_refund_compensation):
"""I don't understand how I can't use my global upgrade when I've done everything you've asked. Also upgrade certs not on app"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Sorry to hear you’re having trouble. Please DM us your confirmation # so we can look into your Global Upgrade certificates and get this sorted.
